mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 3.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures that trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS show positive MoM growth, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100k MoM) signals robust economic expansion and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 100k MoM, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in industrial production (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing and services output, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has risen over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) level below 1200 thousand units indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 1200, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) indicate a delayed monetary response to inflation, causing equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), reduced manufacturing output signals economic weakness and lower corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
